outcome.analysis_limit: The Environment response envelope carried the cursor, but a consumer holding only the derived projection could not identify the page offset or continue offset from that projection.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Environmental capability projections omit the evidence page cursor
pressure_hypothesis.basis: One live campaign-state page exposed eight evidence references and a next offset in the outer response, while the ready environmental_capability source summary exposed only the total count and truncation flag.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Include the analyzed evidence page offset, page limit, and next offset in the projection source summary, including compact responses.
